name: foxhole-vpn
description: Free system-wide VPN for Linux, macOS and Windows using Firefox's built-in VPN (IP Protection): SOCKS5/HTTP proxy + TUN routing, in a terminal UI (unofficial)

scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && node -e "fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755)"
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/global.test.mjs && node test/proxy.test.mjs && node test/dns.test.mjs && node test/update.test.mjs && node test/darwin.test.mjs && node test/win32.test.mjs && node test/tokenserver.test.mjs && node test/guardian.test.mjs && node test/netinfo.test.mjs && node test/settings.test.mjs

author: Dier Cohen
